column1: # Last real data refresh: 2026-08-20 — FFIEC Schedule RI-B Part II, 14 matrix-cohort banks x 12 contiguous quarters. PURPOSE: reserve RUNWAY = ACL / TTM charge-offs, built at DAEDALUS's request to instrument FLG's K-3 kill cell. ★ REQ-1 DELIVERABLE IN ITS OWN RIGHT: per_chargeoffs_K is the PER-QUARTER series derived from YTD by differencing WITH THE Q1 RESET HANDLED (a 3/31 YTD figure IS that quarter's flow; every other quarter = YTD minus prior-quarter YTD within the same year). basis column records which rule produced each cell. ★ REQ-2: window_has_nontie flags any 4-quarter TTM window containing a quarter that fails the ACL identity (38% of windows — HIGHER than the 24.4% per-quarter rate because a 4-quarter window catches more). A runway figure resting on an adjusted quarter is VISIBLE, not silently absorbed. ⚠️ KNOWN BIAS, and it points PESSIMISTIC: runway assumes the trailing charge-off rate PERSISTS. For a bank mid-DISPOSITION (charge-offs elevated by deliberate asset sales rather than a run rate) it UNDERSTATES runway. EGBN is exactly that case — read its 0.53yr with the July 'de-risking through realized loss' grade beside it. ⚠️ Quarter column is M/D/YYYY: PARSE, never lexicographically sort. CADENCE: QUARTERLY alongside MI3/NDFI/ACL screens, next due 2026-11-07; JWT expires 2026-11-05.
